text:
Milestone Checks
Are any milestones missing?
Any missing entries in the following table must be fixed:

Codecheck_missing <- redcap %>% filter(sitting == "Missing" | belly == "Missing" | crawl == "Missing" | cruise == "Missing" | walk == "Missing") %>% 
  select(id, session, all_of(cols))

if (nrow(check_missing) == 0) {
  print("No missing rows")
} else {
  print(check_missing)
}

  id session sitting   belly   crawl  cruise    walk
1 23       4 Missing Missing Missing Missing Missing
2 26       4 Missing Missing Missing Missing Missing
3 33       3 Missing Missing Missing Missing Missing
4 34       3     Yes     Yes Missing      No      No


Are any dates impossible?
Any dates in the following table must be fixed because they occurred after the visit:

Codecheck_dates <- redcap %>% filter(sit_date > visit_date | belly_date > visit_date | crawl_date > visit_date | cruise_date > visit_date | walk_date > visit_date) %>% 
  select(id, all_of(dates))

if (nrow(check_dates) == 0) {
  print("No impossible dates")
} else {
  print(check_dates)
}

[1] "No impossible dates"


Are milestone dates consistent across visits?
✔ Yes, ✖ Never Observed, ❌ No (Needs to be Fixed)

Coderedcap %>% group_by(id) %>% summarize(Sit = n_distinct(sit_date, na.rm = T), Belly = n_distinct(belly_date, na.rm = T), Crawl = n_distinct(crawl_date, na.rm = T), Cruise = n_distinct(cruise_date, na.rm = T), Walk = n_distinct(walk_date, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  reactable( 
          filterable = TRUE, 
          compact = TRUE,
          striped = TRUE,
          defaultPageSize = 50,
          defaultSorted = c("id"),
          columns = list(
            id = colDef(format = colFormat(digits = 0), maxWidth = 50, align = "left"),
            Sit = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"}),
            Belly = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"}),
            Crawl = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"}),
            Cruise = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"}),
            Walk = colDef(maxWidth = 90, cell = function(value) {if (value == 1) "\u2714\ufe0f" else if (value == 0) "\u2716" else "\u274c"})
            ))





Have infants acquired milestones by expected ages?
Session 1 (7 months)

Codesummarize_milestones <- function(s) {
  bind_cols(
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(sitting, name = "sit_n", .drop = F)},
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(belly, name = "belly_n", .drop = F)},
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(crawl, name = "hk_n", .drop = F)},
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(cruise, name = "cruise_n", .drop = F)},
  {redcap %>% filter(session == s) %>% count(walk, name = "walk_n", .drop = F)})
}

  mutate(onset_age = time_length(interval(dob, sit_date),unit = "month")) %>% ungroup()

Users can load data by running (requires one-time google drive authentication):

Codelibrary(tidyverse)
library(pins)
library(nanoparquet)
library(googledrive)

# Load the board of pinned data sets (authenticated users only)
board <- board_gdrive(path = as_id("1OZlphhu6vYm1A2Bm2-zD7a4luS5nGWgS")) 

# To see available pinned data
board %>% pin_list()

# To read the raw IMU predictions throughout the day
ds <- board %>% pin_read("imu_raw_samples") %>%
  filter(nap_period == 0, exclude_period == 0)

# To read REDCap data (AIMS, Demographics, caregiver surveys, motor milestones)
redcap <- board %>% pin_read("redcap_data")

# To read the hourly EMA REDCap data
ema <- board %>% pin_read("ema")

# To read sleep and target-child-directed speech predictions from LENA
sleep_tcds <- board %>% pin_read("sleep_tcds")


Usable data

Codeusable_data <- ds %>% count(id, session) %>% mutate(usable_hours = n/3600)
recording_duration <- ds %>% group_by(id, session) %>% 
  mutate(recording_hours = as.numeric(max(time) - min(time))) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup
  
usable_data %>% left_join(recording_duration) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(usable_hours, recording_hours, show = c("mean", "sd","min","max")) %>% 
  flextable() %>% autofit()
